name: Crooked Effigy

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Crooked Thorns
traits.summary: At the start of its turns, 1d10 Psychic to any creature it is grappling or that is grappling it.
traits.text: At the start of each of the effigy's turns, it deals 5 (1d10) Psychic damage to any creature it is grappling and to any creature that is grappling it. (The Impale action carries the damage to a creature the effigy holds; the other case is the code's.)

traits.name: Old Bindings
traits.summary: Takes an extra 10 Force damage when hit by an attack roll made with Smith's Tools or Tinker's Tools.
traits.text: The effigy takes an extra 10 Force damage when it is hit by an attack roll made with Smith's Tools or Tinker's Tools, which count as a Club or a Light Hammer for the attack.

actions.name: Impale
actions.summary: +5, 1d10+3 Piercing; a Medium or smaller target is Grappled on a branch arm (escape DC 13, two arms) and Restrained.
actions.text: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage. A Medium or smaller target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of its two branch arms, and is Restrained until the grapple ends. A creature it holds takes the Crooked Thorns damage at the start of the effigy's turns.

summary: A bark-and-thorn servant of the Crooked Queen that spears foes on its branch arms and holds them against its thorns.
